entries.title: The Underbog
body: The last of Coilfang Reservoir's natural life that Lady Vashj's naga have not stamped out, home to the most powerful beasts of Zangarmarsh. Only one structure here is theirs: the shrine they built to house their hydra god.

entries.title: The Underspore
body: A fungal cavern where a very special plant, the Underspore, has been tended to perfection for millennia.

entries.title: The Hydra's Shrine
body: The naga's only work in the Underbog: a structure built to house Ghaz'an, the hydra they worship.

entries.title: The Untamed Depths
body: The wildest reaches of the Underbog, where a Broken lord hides among the beasts and the Black Stalker hunts.

entries.title: Hungarfen
body: A huge fungal giant, one of the leaders of his kind, who has tended the Underspore for millennia.

entries.title: Ghaz'an
body: A hydra the naga of Coilfang keep and revere as a god.

entries.title: Swamplord Musel'ek
body: A Broken hunter, ruler of the Murkblood, with his beast Claw. Why he lives down here among the animals rather than with his own people is a puzzle; he may be in exile, hiding in the untamed Underbog.

entries.title: The Black Stalker
body: A great sporebat that hunts the deepest part of the Underbog.
